messages.subject: ggplot2 ebooks
parts:
This might be a bit on the entry level side for most list members, but you might know somebody that could use it. I noticed that Packtpub has a $5 ebook sale. Now granted the quality varies greatly (they have an R and hadoop title that is extremely disapointing), but they have a few R and ggplot2 titles that might be worth a look:

https://www.packtpub.com/all/?search=ggplot2#

Francois
